name: Mixpost
description: Mixpost Lite is a self-hosted social media management tool. It lets you create, schedule and publish posts to Facebook pages, X and Mastodon from one place, with a content calendar, a media library and multiple accounts per network.

notes.text: Sign in with ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD from /opt/mixpost_data/.env inside the container.

Connecting social accounts needs a public domain: set APP_URL in /opt/mixpost_data/.env, then run `php artisan optimize` in /opt/mixpost. Facebook and X also need your own developer app keys under Services.
